preview.versioning: New compatible hover feature makes the next release minor. The exporter overrides staged project/platform version metadata; tracked source remains at its 1.4.0 base version until release preparation. Shipping patched 1.4.0 runtimes and native libraries are unchanged.

changes: Retained immutable CPU figure positions/indices remove gameplay GPU readbacks from rain shelter and footprint setup.
Exact small-component bounds skip unrelated relocation candidates without changing ray order, rounding or endpoints.
Neighbourhood component rejection avoids repeated endpoint floods. Prepared route checks use reachable endpoint seeds only, preventing an unrelated component flood beside a valid route.
Severed parts use bounded actual-mesh support points, gravity, outward impulse, repeated contact response, friction, gradual slope alignment and low-energy settling.
A fear/retreat order replaces an existing patrol or investigation immediately; an existing retreat is retained.
World hover uses the spell tooltip renderer and shares the authoritative effective Use/Steal, nearest-even rounding and quest-key check. Missing creature/corpse titles have localized fallbacks.

performance.hardware: Ubuntu 24.04.5, NVIDIA RTX 3090, patched Godot 4.7 shipping runtime, Vulkan Forward+, isolated user profiles

suslanger.method: Very High, actual 2560x1440 render viewport, 60 simulated seconds warm-up plus completed rain cover, then 10 seconds stationary and 10 seconds camera orbit. One game instance; no concurrent build or benchmark. Full simulation remains enabled.

mansion.result: Persistent post-warm-up spikes were not reproduced locally. CPU geometry reuse fixes confirmed synchronous readbacks while the rain-cover map is built, but that alone does not explain persistent drops after several minutes.

ingos.method: All seven LiA Ingos zones; seeded simulation, 200 warm-up ticks plus 600 measured ticks (44 simulated seconds total). Headless simulation timings, not rendered FPS.
ingos.town_regression: An intermediate prepared-route implementation caused a 50 ms unrelated component flood for Cow 44394502. Fixed by inspecting only reachable goal seeds; final town maximum 4.811 ms. Regression now asserts the unrelated room remains unlabelled.

performance.scope: Local single-run comparisons. Final source includes 1.4.0 changes and the new archer behavior; the 1.3.1 performance-only comparison isolates geometry reuse and small-component relocation. No Windows or user-hardware FPS claim.

visual.scope: Rendered Linux Vulkan at 1600x900; actual localized text archives plus RemakeText. Tooltips use the shared spell style, fit the viewport and disappear when effective skill qualifies. Limb ground contact was inspected after settling.

network.method: Real ENet external guest and rendered host frontend with a separate authoritative LocalHost worker. Ready-synchronized 12-second short, long and mixed command bursts (~18–20 commands/s), then a 12-second settle phase. Reachable map destinations at about 3 m and 20 m. Separate isolated profiles.
network.jump_definition: Drawn displacement > max(1.5 m, 15 m/s * frame duration). Smaller visible corrections are reported as step/error distributions, not asserted absent.
network.simulation: Built-in latency/jitter/loss injection at both peers; not an actual ZeroTier overlay. Harsh case also injects a 180 ms guest frame stall every 4 seconds.
network.conclusion: Reported teleporting was not reproduced in the baseline or candidates. No networking algorithm/protocol change is claimed. CPU stall fixes address a plausible contributing delay, not a proven network root cause.

small_step_analysis.finding: Largest sampled displacement matches continuous smoothing during the long engine frame; no separate discontinuous position jump was identified. Post-render sampling can span multiple frames; wall sampling intervals are retained alongside the actual engine delta.

limits: Windows package export and resource audit passed; native Windows gameplay was not run.
Persistent mansion dips and the reported multiplayer teleport were not reproduced under the tested conditions.
Local test runs used isolated profiles and generated fixtures. User saves were not modified.
No tag, release, hosted browser export or remote repository was published.

prior_component_checks.scope: Earlier unpublished preview; the geometry, weather, footprint and severed-limb implementation files are byte-identical to the final preview.
